below-only-trace.interpretation: Host next trace traverses the run beneath this hook, not its own or preceding links.

host-diagnostic-sink.interpretation: The chain diagnostic sink forwards logs to the supported debug logger; ordinary trace entries are not emitted here.

loader-pre-admission-log.interpretation: Loaded-module diagnostic occurs before LKe returns admitted/refused sets; loaded is not admission.

next-readonly-trace.interpretation: Host freezes next; its trace getter is supplied by the dispatch chain.

trace-settle-values.interpretation: Host records received argument and returned value when a link settles.

supportedDebugLimitation: Module loaded diagnostics precede admission and do not provide normal per-link received/returned value receipts or next invocation counts.
versionAuthority: Previously independently verified exact bytes; no new executable invocation in this preflight
